title: GCL Quality Summary
description: Aggregated output from scripts/gcl_trace_aggregate.py (AGENTS.md GCL Phase 3). Owned by qcloud-monitor-ops; consumed by gcl-quality-dashboard.md and proactive-inspection reporting embed.

critic_mode_counts.description: F14 — runs bucketed by Critic provenance (iterations[-1].critic._mode written by scripts/gcl_runner.py). Non-empty `missing` means the trace predates the provenance field; a non-zero `structural-only-fallback` means rule-based scores were substituted after an LLM Critic failure (timeout / rate limit / invalid JSON) and MUST NOT be read as LLM-Critic verdicts.

structural_fallback_runs.description: Explicit count of `structural-only-fallback` runs (0 when none).

structural_fallback_ratio.description: structural_fallback_runs / totals.total_runs (0.0 for an empty window).

structural_fallback_max_ratio.description: Threshold actually applied, read from assets/shared/thresholds.json key `gcl_structural_fallback_max_ratio`. Missing/invalid config fails closed to 0.0.

structural_fallback_breach.description: true when structural_fallback_ratio exceeds structural_fallback_max_ratio. Alarm paths must treat true as 'pass_rate is rule-based, not LLM-scored'.

structural_fallback_threshold_configured.description: false when the threshold was absent/invalid and fail-closed to 0.0 was applied.
